title: Universal Average-Mixing Barriers, Conference-Graph Extremality, and Exact Diophantine Uniformization for Continuous-Time Quantum Walks on Strongly Regular Graphs
abstract: We establish three exact structural theorems governing the Cesaro average mixing matrix and generalized uniform average mixing (UAM) of continuous-time quantum walks U(t) = exp(-itA) on primitive strongly regular graphs SRG(n, k, lambda, mu). First, we prove that the Cesaro average mixing matrix M_hat = sum_theta E_theta^{o 2} is strictly rational for every SRG (even for irrational conference spectra) and satisfies the unconditional return-probability barrier M_hat_{uu} = (1 + m_r^2 + m_s^2)/n^2 >= (n^2 - 2n + 3)/(2n^2) > 1/n for all n >= 4, attaining equality if and only if G is a conference graph (n = 4t + 1, k = 2t, lambda = t - 1, mu = t). Furthermore, the off-diagonal mixing imbalance satisfies the closed-form identity M_hat_adj - M_hat_nonadj = 2(n - 2k + lambda - mu)/(n Delta), which negates identically under graph complementation and vanishes if and only if the Seidel eigenvalue theta_0 = n - 1 - 2k equals the exact midpoint (theta_r + theta_s)/2. Second, solving the non-conference off-diagonal Cesaro uniformity Diophantine system (n - 1) Delta = n((2k - n + 1)^2 + (n - 1)), we discover an infinite polynomial parameter family n(t) = (t + 1)(4t + 1)^2, k(t) = t(2t + 1)(4t + 3), mu(t) = 2t(t + 1)(2t + 1), r = t, s = -(2t + 1)^2, m_s = t(4t + 3) whose Cesaro mixing matrix has constant off-diagonal probability; both Krein inequalities hold unconditionally for all t >= 1, while the absolute bound fails uniquely at t = 1 (50 > 35) and holds strictly for every t >= 2 (realized at t = 2 by the ternary Golay dual coset graph SRG(243, 110, 37, 60)). Exhaustive zero-float search up to n <= 1200 certifies that only t = 2 (n = 243) and t = 3 (n = 676) (and complements) survive Krein and absolute-bound filtering. Third, formulating generalized UAM over arbitrary observation-time distributions via exact rational affine moment lines c_1(c_3), c_2(c_3) in [-1, 1]^3, we prove unconditionally that every member t >= 1 of our off-diagonal Cesaro-uniform family obeys max c_1(c_3) = -(16t^3 + 8t^2 + t - 1)/2 <= -12 < -1 and hence admits NO UAM under any time law (separating off-diagonal Cesaro uniformity from UAM), alongside empty-polytope UAM obstructions on Schlafli and Higman-Sims, exact 16x16 Hadamard involution instantaneous uniform mixing at t = pi/4 on Clebsch, L_2(4), and Shrikhande, and a 16-graph zero-float mixing atlas. A two-layer verification artifact accompanies the paper: 20 constructive, axiom-free Lean 4.36.0 theorems formalizing the barrier, complement, t-family, Krein, absolute-bound, and moment-line kernel, paired with 16 zero-float Python certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
